aggressive_definition: Aggressive prostate cancer defined as high-grade and/or advanced-stage prostate cancer.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: Using a case-control design and self-administered questionnaire, we examined the association between APC (high grade and/or advanced stage) and frequency and quantity of alcohol intake 2 years prior to enrolment.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: The study included 1282 APC cases and 951 controls.
reason: The study explicitly evaluates incident aggressive prostate cancer, defined as high grade and/or advanced stage, among cases and controls. It does not report an overall prostate cancer analysis.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Beer intake frequency of ⩾5 days per week was associated with increased risk compared with no beer intake (odds ratio=1.66, 95% confidence interval: 1.12-2.48) whereas wine was protective at all frequencies of consumption compared with those with no wine intake.
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate is from a case-control analysis whose cases were explicitly defined as aggressive prostate cancer cases.
